<thought>We need to locate the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target product (which generated the two precursors listed earlier), reproduces the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction. The reaction forms a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester, so we’ll search the template catalog for templates that form “C‑C double bonds” and “carboxylic esters”. Since the exact product SMILES isn’t provided, we’ll use one of the known precursors as a proxy to retrieve candidate templates; later we can identify the correct one by checking which template matches the transformation between the product and the two precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CO)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
